Susan / Sean — copying in a few suggested edits to the Order Form/Master Services Agreement language to make sure our COI issuance aligns with Hawthorne's procurement requirements. Below are my notes and proposed wording.

(Please see attached: Redlined_Order_Form.docx for inline changes)

Key proposed language (for quick copy/paste into the order form):

1) Additional Insured: "To the extent permitted by law, Redwood shall name Customer (Hawthorne Analytics, Inc.) as an additional insured under Redwood's Commercial General Liability policy for claims arising out of Redwood's performance under this Agreement. Such coverage shall be primary and non-contributory with respect to any other insurance available to Customer."

2) Waiver of Subrogation: "Redwood waives rights of subrogation against Customer to the extent such waiver is permitted under the applicable policy and law, for Commercial General Liability and Auto Liability."

3) Cyber/E&O: "Redwood maintains Cyber Liability insurance with limits not less than $5,000,000 per claim and $5,000,000 aggregate and Professional Liability/Errors & Omissions insurance with limits not less than $3,000,000 per claim. Evidence of such coverage (COI and insurer binder) will be provided upon execution of the Order Form, and Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain any endorsements required by Customer. If Customer requires specific insurer forms or endorsements (e.g., CG 2010), Customer will notify Redwood at least five (5) business days prior to the requested certificate delivery date to allow broker procurement."

Practical notes:
- If Hawthorne requires policy endorsements (versus a COI note), many carriers require an additional 3-5 business days to issue endorsements.
- For primary/non-contributory and waiver of subrogation, some carriers decline depending on the policy wording — our broker can request an endorsement but it is not always guaranteed. We should set expectations that the COI + binder will be delivered and endorsements requested.

Sean — if you confirm Hawthorne's exact entity name + address, I'll prepare the redline to the Order Form and include the proposed text above.
